title: SYNTHIA: Synthetic Yet Naturally Tailored Human-Inspired PersonAs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting language models primed with synthetic backstories to self-report their age, and calculating the Wasserstein distance between the resulting age distribution and baseline/real-world demographic datasets.

Prompting language models primed with synthetic backstories to self-report their gender identity, and calculating the Wasserstein distance between the resulting gender distribution and benchmark datasets.

Prompting language models primed with synthetic backstories to self-report their racial or ethnic groups, and comparing the probability mass function of these demographics against existing datasets using Wasserstein distance.

Prompting language models primed with synthetic backstories to self-report their highest level of education and annual household income, then comparing these distributions to benchmark datasets to assess representational diversity.
